notes.title: Pocket Kingdom now in German and Ukrainian!
Pocket Kingdom now in German and Ukrainian!
Looking for proofreading volunteers
notes.content:
[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/a606bfd495fb1a5507ad6c6c1eb7600e/tumblr_ohgtiiSqKf1qjja0co1_540.gif[/img]

Hey guys! We have prepared French and Japanese localizations, but turned out localizators did a lazy job and quality of it is quite questionable. So, if you are a native speaker of those languages, and ready to volunteraly fix the translaton - contact us via yanrishatum@gmail.com . Gotta fill localization credits with actually normal people who can speak language they lozalized to. ;)

To other news, I want to say huge thanks to Innocentive for proofreading german localization. As well as sorry for enormously delayed patch 1.0.9. We've encountered unexpected problems with Windows XP support, engine version migration and other tasks. I hope patch will go live pretty soon, as most of that issues now solved.

notes.title: Pocket Kingdom Sountrack is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hMHAk3l.png[/img]

Hey guys, we are happy to announce that Sountrack DLC is now available. If you want to specifically tip the musician for the music, now you can! In addition, Pocket Kingdom now have the Game+OST bundle with a bit cheaper price than separate game and OST. Stay tuned, as we have other news and quite delayed patch 1.0.9 underway.
